comment: Independent do.c dropz() witness for an unpaid item dropped on a shop square that is not costly. On the D:5 general store of seed 8510310 (also used by the unpaid-container-return recipe), a debug Healer picks up a scroll for sale, teleports with ^T onto the shop's open door (a shop square for u.ushops, but not costly_spot()) and drops it there: shk.c sellobj() returns at its costly_spot() test, so C prints only "You drop ... (unpaid, 53 zorkmids)." and the scroll stays on the bill. She picks it up again and waits.
